goal: Refactor src/args.js into two exported functions. tokenize(argv) returns one token per argument, in order: { kind: 'long', name, value } for an argument starting with "--" (value only when it has an "="), { kind: 'short', name } for one starting with a single "-" and longer than one character, and { kind: 'positional', value } for anything else. parseArgs(argv) must then be built on tokenize. This is a pure refactor: parseArgs must return exactly what it returns today for every input, including unusual ones, so do not fix or change any existing behaviour while you restructure it.
